State Bank Financial Corporation operates as the bank holding firm for State Bank and Trust Company that provides various community banking services to individuals and businesses. The company has market cap of $1.29 billion. It offers a range of deposit services and products, such as checking, commercial operating, savings and money market, individual retirement, and time deposit accounts, as well as short-term to longer-term certificates of deposits. It has a 28.47 P/E ratio. The firm also provides residential and commercial construction and development, commercial real estate, farmland and agricultural production, residential mortgage, home equity, and consumer loans, as well as loans to small and medium-sized businesses.
